% normal glossary
\newglossaryentry{item:whole}{%
  name={whole},plural={wholes},
  description={%
    Finite set of \glspl{item:part} \ldots
  },%
  shortdesc={Set of \glspl{item:part}.}
}
\newglossaryentry{item:part}{%
  name={part},plural={parts},
  description={%
    Component of a \gls{item:whole} \ldots
  },%
  shortdesc={Uniquely marked part of a \gls{item:whole}.}
}

\newglossaryentry{item:outer-factor}{%
  name={outer factor}, plural={outer factors},
  description={%
    A factor defined outside of the \gls{item:whole} and its expressions. Its change can yield completely different values inferred by the helper.
  },%
  shortdesc={Factors outside of a \gls{item:whole}[wholes] control}%
}

\newglossaryentry{def:same-look}{%
  name={visual match},
  first={visual match [first use!]},
  description={%
    Two \glspl{item:whole}~\(A\) and~\(B\) have the same observable shape for all \textit{labels} they do have in common\ldots
  },%
  shortdesc={%
    All \textit{labels} in common evaluate to the same value for all outer factors.%
  }%
}


% acronyms
\newacronym{aaa}{AAA}{Alpha Alpha Alpha}
\newacronym{bbb}{BBB}{Beta Beta Beta}
\newacronym{ccc}{CCC}{Gamma Gamma Gamma}
\newacronym[plural={Delta Delta items}]{net:ddd}{DDD item}{Delta Delta item}


% notations
\newglossaryentry{not:N}{%
  name={Natural Number}, symbol={\ensuremath{\mathbb{N}}},
  type={notation},
  description={%
    Describes the set of non negative integers: \(\{1, 2, \ldots\}\). If~\(0\) is to be included, it is indexed as \(\mathbb{N}_0\).
  },%
  shortdesc={%
    Set of non-negative ints.
  }%
}

\newglossaryentry{not:Z}{%
  name={Integer}, symbol={\ensuremath{\mathbb{Z}}},
  type={notation},
  description={%
    Describes the set of non negative as well as the negative integers: \(\{\ldots, -1, 0, 1, 2, \ldots\}\).
  },%
  shortdesc={%
    Set of integers.
  }%
}


\newglossaryentry{not:R}{%
  name={real number}, symbol={\ensuremath{\mathbb{R}}},
  type={notation},
  description={%
    Describes the set of real numbers.
  },%
  shortdesc={%
    Set of real numbers.
  }%
}

\newglossaryentry{not:C}{%
  name={Complex}, symbol={\ensuremath{\mathbb{C}}}, type={notation},
  description={Describes the set of complex numbers.},
  shortdesc={Set of complex numbers.}%
}

\newglossaryentry{not:P}{%
  name={powerset}, symbol={\ensuremath{\mathcal{P}}},
  type={notation},
  description={%
    With \(\P(X)\) we denote the powerset of a set \(X\). That is, the set of all subsets of \(X\), including the empty set and \(X\) itself.
  },%
  shortdesc={%
    Describes the powerset \(\P(X)\) of a set \(X\).
  }%
}
